title: Telescopic Spray Gun – for Garden & Car Wash
descriptionHtml:
Reach all the way – without getting wet

Watering high hanging pots, rinsing the gutter or reaching under the car with a regular spray gun is nearly impossible. You stretch, spill and get your arm wet.

Longer reach, full control

The telescopic spray gun extends so you can reach high and far without stretching. The ergonomic handle lets you adjust the spray from a gentle shower to a powerful jet – perfect for both delicate plants and a dirty car.

Features

  • Telescopic design that reaches high and far
  • Adjustable spray – from shower to powerful jet
  • Ergonomic handle that feels good in the hand
  • For watering, car washing, pet baths and outdoor cleaning
  • Durable construction that handles all the season's weather

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
